links.outcome: Comparability of ViT and LMM evaluations; matched test sets and sample sizes
links.effect: ViT and LMM evaluations used different test sets and sample sizes, so estimates do not support direct comparison of model superiority; exemplar-test disjointness could not be confirmed.
links.quote: Because the ViT and LMM evaluations used different test sets and sample sizes, these estimates do not support a direct comparison of model superiority.

unlisted_practices: Automated triage of non-informative frames in surgical videos to support video review and storage management

screen.reason: Evaluates domain-specific vision transformers and general-purpose multimodal foundation models (GPT-4o-mini, LLaVA) on the benchmark task of automated triage/filtering of non-informative surgical video frames, without evaluating an organizational deployment practice.
